summary:
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — [#1663](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1663) fixes `Geant4Output2EDM4hep`, `Geant4Output2LCIO` and `Geant4Output2ROOT` so that ingested run/file parameters actually reach the output in multi-threaded mode and locks the `endRun` action correctly (fixes #1660); tests now compare run and metadata trees when present. [#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681) removes the CSG-based DDCAD ASSIMP export path because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private, temporarily dropping CAD export functionality (a replacement using only public ROOT interfaces is being prepared in #1682). [#1666](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1666) adds a new `kUpstreamTrapezoid` type in `OtherDetectorHelpers.h` and extends `Mask_o1_v01_geo.cpp` to handle non-cylindrically-symmetric FCC MDI synchrotron radiation masks.
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — [#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524) hides the deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload from Cling/cppyy, which had been selecting the wrong overload; a stop-gap until the deprecated method is removed (fixes #523).
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — [#658](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/658) introduces `MuSIC_v3` with instrumented nozzles: three silicon Forward Tracker disks are embedded in air gaps inside each nozzle, the vertex barrel/endcap layer count and IDs are corrected, and the yoke iron is removed in favour of using the HCAL barrel as the magnetic flux return (with duplicated files consolidated by reusing v2 where possible). [#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662) maps volumes to their closest predefined ROOT colour to improve display consistency (partial fix for #616), and [#651](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/651) refreshes CODEOWNERS to reduce notification noise and better reflect current maintainership.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — [#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431) adds `--evt-max` as an alias to `k4run` to make clearer the correspondence with `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax`. [#427](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/427) refactors the test components to use functional algorithms, replacing legacy ROOT-file and Marlin-wrapper producers and consolidating CellID metadata and output-collection checks.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — [#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104) adapts to the new `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct from acts-project/acts#6123 while retaining compatibility with released ACTS versions using the old pair. [#98](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/98) and [#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/102) chase further ACTS API changes (propagator, grid-bin finder, material-binning `AxisSpec`), which will break k4ActsTracking builds against older ACTS releases and prompted discussion about pinning ACTS versions in the Key4hep nightlies. [#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97) makes `--compactFile` required in `CLD_CKFTracking.py`, `runGNNTrackFinding.py`, and `test_visualize_acts_geo.py`, replacing a cryptic Gaudi `TypeError` with a clear argparse error.
- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora)** — [#54](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/54) fixes PFO comparison to work with the current EDM4hep interface following key4hep/EDM4hep#520.
- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — [#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15) shrinks children volumes that share size and position with their parent so that overlapping geometry renders distinctly, cleans up the conversion logic in `handleInput.ts`, reduces the default `numFaces` build option to 1000, raises transparency to 100%, and fixes a missing-field bug in `concatenateOutput.ts`.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — [#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386) extends the tracking-validation option (from #379) to the IDEA full-sim digitization/reconstruction steering and exposes `--addTruthTracks`/`--runTrkValidation` via the IDEA and ALLEGRO ctest wrapper scripts.
- **[hep-fcc/FCCeePhysicsStudies](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies)** — [#61](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCeePhysicsStudies/pull/61) adds updated FSR lattice beam parameters (still based on GHC while LCC values above the Z pole are unavailable; IP-level differences are small).
- **[hep-fcc/fcc-drs](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs)** — [#88](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-drs/pull/88) adds a coordinator-only `production_ids` table to track DIRAC/iLCDirac production IDs (with optional labels) on campaign-assigned requests, with UI/server-side enforcement and activity-feed logging.
- **[key4hep/k4Bench](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench)** — [#187](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/187) changes the regression engine to judge memory using `peak_vmem_mb` and `mean_rss_anon_mb` (immune to CVMFS page invalidation) while keeping existing RSS values as reported-only diagnostics; [#188](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/188) adds a reported-only Theil-Sen anonymous RSS-growth slope in MB/event, an event-timing JSON schema version, and measurement-stability info in the dashboard.
- **[hep-fcc/fcc-tutorials](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials)** — [#198](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials/pull/198) refreshes the eedE README with new interface screenshots and documentation for its new features, and [#201](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/fcc-tutorials/pull/201) switches the tutorial to link `dd4hep2root` from k4geo instead of shipping a static copy.
